name: Monday.com
summary: Connect Monday.com and read or create boards, items, and comments through Composio OAuth.
description: Link Monday.com, browse boards/items, create items/boards/comments, and update item columns through Composio. Board and item actions show progress and result cards. Desktop notifications are reserved for connecting and disconnecting Monday.com.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Composio API key
preferences.description: Your project API key from the Composio dashboard. Monday credentials are managed by Composio.

blocks.text: Save your Composio API key, then say ‘connect me to Monday.com’ to authorize in your browser. Say ‘disconnect Monday.com’ to unlink this installation. Connecting again verifies an existing active connection.

If Monday says ‘App is not installed’, an admin must first install Composio's Monday app using the link in this integration's README. Then retry Connect. Once connected, ask to list your Monday boards or read items from a board.

tools.name: connect_account
tools.title: Connect Monday.com
tools.description: Connect Monday.com through Composio OAuth. Use when asked to connect, authorize, reconnect, or verify the saved Monday.com connection. Verify an active saved account; otherwise open browser authorization and immediately return pending with its link. After browser approval, run Connect again to verify. Only report connected when connected=true; no background sidebar result is scheduled.

children.text: Continue in your browser to link Monday.com through Composio, then run Connect again to verify. If already connected, we will verify your saved connection now.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.title: Monday.com account
tools.description: Show Monday.com connection status with Connect, Disconnect, and Refresh controls. Use when asked about Monday.com account settings, connection status, expired authorization, or account linking. Read only; does not start OAuth.

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.title: Disconnect Monday.com
tools.description: Disconnect this installation's Monday.com account. Use only when asked to disconnect or unlink Monday.com. Revoke authorization when supported; otherwise disable the Composio connection. Does not delete boards, items, or users.

children.text: Disconnect this installation's saved Monday.com account. You can reconnect later.
Your boards, items, comments, and board memberships will remain.

tools.name: get_boards
tools.title: Get Monday.com boards
tools.description: Find Monday.com boards with optional ID, workspace, state, and visibility filters. When the user asks for tasks on a named board, use this as an intermediate lookup. Prefer an exact board-name match, use a unique clear partial match automatically, and ask when multiple boards could match. Then call get_items with the resolved board_id and exact board_name before answering. For a general board list request, use the short message and let the glance card show the names. Use the full records from the current page for board-specific follow-ups, including boards outside the preview. Pagination starts at page 1. When pagination.nextPage is available, offer to check for more boards and use that page with the previous filters and limit if asked. Counts describe the returned page. Keep IDs internal unless explicitly requested. Read only; does not start OAuth or send notifications.

tools.name: get_items
tools.title: Get Monday.com items
tools.description: List Monday.com items when the user asks to view or retrieve them. A bare board name in answer to a pending create-item board question selects the destination for prepare_create_item. Use exactly one of ids, board_id, or cursor. For a named board, first resolve its ID with get_boards: prefer an exact match, otherwise use a unique clear partial match; ask if ambiguous. Pass the exact resolved board_name for display and name that board in the final task answer. Never present get_boards results as tasks; wait for this call to succeed before listing tasks, or report its error. Item-ID reads support page, newest_first, and exclude_nonactive; pagination.nextPage is a possible next page. Board reads include column values and optionally group_id. For an explicit next-page request, use pagination.nextCursor with the previous limit and optional board_name display context. For a general list request, use the short message and let the glance card show the names. Offer to show the next page when there is a cursor, or offer to narrow by group when appropriate. Use the full records from the current page to answer item-specific follow-ups, including items outside the preview. Counts describe the returned page. Keep IDs internal unless explicitly requested, and use only confirmed IDs and names. Read only; does not start OAuth or send notifications.

board_name.description: Exact board name from a prior get_boards result, for display only. Never invent a name or use it instead of board_id. May be carried forward with a cursor.

tools.name: prepare_create_item
tools.title: Prepare Monday.com item
tools.description: Use this tool for item creation or edits to the latest pending Create item confirmation. A correction to the board on an Archive board or Delete board confirmation belongs to prepare_archive_board or prepare_delete_board, respectively. Start every Monday item creation here. An explicit item rename, or "change the name to …" while the Create item confirmation is active, changes item_name. Pass the new item_name and replaces_draft_id, or revises_item_name with the previous item name. Omit board and group fields unless the user asks to change them. Never use create_board for an item rename. If it is unclear which name the user means, ask whether they mean the board or the item. A follow-up such as 'change the board to voiceos' after a Create item card means change the pending item's destination. For that correction, call this tool with the new board_name and replaces_draft_id. If the pending ID is missing from the context, pass revises_item_name with the exact pending item's name from this conversation. If neither is known, ask which pending item should go on the requested board. Board renaming is unavailable. Omitted group and column arguments are carried over on a revision; ask if a requested value cannot be matched. For a new item, pass item_name and the board the user specified in the request, including a clear reference such as 'that board'. Use board_name or a verified board_id. If the user did not specify a destination, omit both board fields and ask the user to choose. Do not infer a destination from past requests or board lists. If the result is board_choices, ask its question as the final response for that turn and wait for the user to say or type a board name. This is a clarification, so do not open a confirmation yet. A bare board name after that question answers it, even if the reply contains no verb. Call prepare_create_item again with that board_name and pending_item.draft_id as replaces_draft_id, or use revises_item_name with pending_item.item_name if the draft ID is unavailable. Do not list boards or items in response to that choice. Once preparation returns create_item_arguments, call create_item for confirmation. This tool only reads Monday. With a resolved board and without item_name or a revision, it returns groups and columns. Pass optional group_id (ID or title; omit for the top group) and only requested column_values keyed by actual column ID or exact title. Use exact status labels, ISO dates, and Monday person names or IDs. Pass create_item_arguments verbatim to create_item. Never silently drop a requested value.

tools.name: create_item
tools.title: Create Monday.com item
tools.description: Use create_item_arguments from prepare_create_item verbatim. For a spoken or typed item rename, or a name edit while this card is active, call prepare_create_item with the pending item draft ID and new item_name. Keep the destination and other values. The confirmation lets the user edit the item name and choose a group on the selected board. Approval creates the item in the selected group. Never say an item was created unless the result confirms its ID. For a voice revision such as 'change the board to voiceos', call prepare_create_item with the new board_name and replaces_draft_id or the pending item's exact name in revises_item_name. Ask about any previously requested value with no clear match. Board renaming is unavailable. Do not retry a write automatically.

children.label: Group and column values

tools.name: prepare_update_item
tools.title: Prepare Monday.com item update
tools.description: Start here when the user wants to edit an existing Monday item or move it to another group on its current board. For a request naming the board and item, call this directly with board_name and item_name. For example, for move task 1 in the testing board to group 2, pass board_name Testing, item_name Task 1, and destination_group Group 2. Do not call get_boards or get_items first when names are supplied. For an item already verified in this conversation, pass item_id and optional verified board_id. Keep IDs internal. If the result includes question, ask it and wait for the answer before preparing again. For a group move, pass destination_group as the group title or a verified group ID on the item’s current board. Include all requested column edits in the same call. With neither column_values nor destination_group this returns the item's editable columns and labels. Pass only requested changes keyed by actual column ID or exact title. Use name for the item name, existing labels for status/dropdown, ISO dates and UTC times, strings for text, numbers for numbers, and booleans for checkboxes. For People, use a name or {names: [...]}, or {operation: 'add' or 'remove', names: [...]} to preserve other assignees. Use null only for an explicit clear. Ask about any unresolved item, column, value, or person before opening a card. For a voice revision of an open Update item card, pass replaces_draft_id and only the parts being revised. If revising column_values, pass the complete desired column set. An omitted destination_group retains the pending move and null removes it. Omit item and board identifiers and names for revisions. Call update_item_values with update_item_arguments verbatim to show one confirmation. This tool only reads Monday.

tools.name: update_item_values
tools.title: Update Monday.com item values
tools.description: Use update_item_arguments from prepare_update_item verbatim to show one Update item confirmation. Approval saves and verifies column edits first, then attempts the reviewed group move. A move may fail after edits are saved. Report both outcomes from the result. Use prepare_update_item for a voice revision before approval. Only report success if the result confirms the changes. Check Monday before retrying an unconfirmed save.

children.label: Proposed changes
children.html:
<!doctype html>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<style>
:root { color: rgba(255,255,255,.88); --muted: rgba(255,255,255,.57); --divider: rgba(255,255,255,.12); font: 12.5px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; }
:root[data-theme="light"] { color: rgba(0,0,0,.88); --muted: rgba(0,0,0,.6); --divider: rgba(0,0,0,.12); }
body { margin: 0; background: transparent; }
dl { margin: 0; max-height: 250px; overflow: auto; }
.row { padding: 7px 0; }
.row + .row { border-top: 1px solid var(--divider); }
dt { font-weight: 600; }
dd { margin: 3px 0 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap: 10px; }
dd span { overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: pre-wrap; }
.caption { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
</style>
<dl aria-label="Proposed changes"></dl>
<script>
const list = document.querySelector('dl');
let height = 0;
new ResizeObserver(() => {
  const next = Math.ceil(document.body.getBoundingClientRect().height);
  if (!next || next === height) return;
  height = next;
  parent.postMessage({ type: 'voiceos:resize', height }, '*');
}).observe(document.body);
addEventListener('message', event => {
  if (event.source !== parent || event.data?.type !== 'voiceos:init') return;
  const changes = event.data.args?.preview?.changes;
  if (!Array.isArray(changes)) return;
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = event.data.theme?.mode === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';
  list.replaceChildren(...changes.map(({ label, before, after }) => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'row';
    const term = document.createElement('dt');
    term.textContent = label;
    const values = document.createElement('dd');
    for (const [caption, value] of [['Current', before], ['Proposed', after]]) {
      const cell = document.createElement('span');
      const heading = document.createElement('span');
      heading.className = 'caption';
      heading.textContent = caption;
      cell.append(heading, document.createTextNode(value));
      values.append(cell);
    }
    row.append(term, values);
    return row;
  }));
});
</script>

tools.name: create_update
tools.title: Create Monday.com update/comment
tools.description: Post a comment/update on a specific existing Monday.com item. Requires item_id and a nonempty body. Do not retry automatically after an uncertain outcome.

tools.name: prepare_create_board
tools.title: Prepare Monday.com board
tools.description: Start every Monday board creation here. Treat a new request to create a board as a fresh draft, even in the same conversation. For a fresh draft, pass only details the user supplied in that request or explicitly asked to reuse. Omit replaces_draft_id. If the user gives no board name, omit board_name and ask for it using the tool result. Never fill in a board name, description, visibility, or workspace from an earlier unrelated request, a prior confirmation, or a previously created board. In "create a board and add an item to it", "it" means the new board in this request. Only when the user also requests an item, set item_follow_up to prepare_confirmation and follow_up_item_name to the name they supplied, or set item_follow_up to ask_name if it is missing. If the user explicitly renames the item before this board is created, revise the same pending board draft with only the updated follow_up_item_name and item_follow_up set to prepare_confirmation. Keep board_name and all other board settings. If a Create item confirmation is already active, use prepare_create_item for a name edit. When both the board and item are plausible targets and the user does not specify which, ask which name they mean before changing either. This shows the next step on the board success screen. Item creation still requires its own confirmation. Set item_follow_up to none if the user drops the item request before approving the board. Use replaces_draft_id only when the user edits the same pending board, such as "change visibility to private", or directly answers a question about it. Pass the latest draft ID and only the changed fields. Older references to the same pending board resolve to its latest revision. If the result has board_draft_status, follow its message. For unavailable, recover quietly only when the conversation confirms the board is still pending. For created, submitting, or unconfirmed, do not restart board creation. Pass workspace by name, null to switch to the default workspace, or description as an empty string to clear it. New boards default to public visibility, an empty description, and the default workspace. If the result has pending_board, ask its question about the missing name or unresolved workspace. When the user replies to that question or edits that same draft, pass pending_board.draft_id as replaces_draft_id. If the result has create_board_arguments, pass them verbatim to create_board for approval. This tool only reads Monday.

tools.name: create_board
tools.title: Create Monday.com board
tools.description: Always show the Create board confirmation, including when the user also requests an item. Use create_board_arguments from the current draft verbatim. For a new create-board request, start with prepare_create_board and use that new draft. The user can edit the name, visibility, description, and workspace. For spoken or typed revisions, use prepare_create_board with the latest draft_id and changed fields. If the result has retry_create_board_arguments, show a fresh Create board confirmation with those arguments verbatim; the card shows Monday's rejection and the user's submitted settings. Wait for the user to edit and approve again. If no retry arguments are returned, report the error and check Monday before considering another create. On success, use item_destination.board_id and item_destination.item_name, when present, for prepare_create_item only if the user also requested an item. Follow the latest item name the user gave. A name edit while the Create item confirmation is active belongs to that item; use prepare_create_item and never reopen this board confirmation for that edit. Omit group_id for the top group unless the user specified a group. If the item name is missing, ask for it and retain this board ID for the reply. Always show a separate Create item confirmation. If the item is cancelled or fails, report that the board was created and the item wasn't confirmed. Resume from item preparation on this board if the user retries. Never create the board again to retry the item.

children.label: Visibility and workspace

tools.name: prepare_create_group
tools.title: Prepare Monday.com group
tools.description: Start here to create an empty group (section) on an existing Monday board. Pass the board name or a verified board ID, the new group name, and any requested position. Position defaults to bottom. For before or after, pass the reference group's name or verified ID in position.reference_group. If the result includes a question, ask it and use pending_group.draft_id as replaces_draft_id when the user answers. To revise the same pending group by voice, pass replaces_draft_id and only the changed fields. For a new request, start a fresh draft. Pass create_group_arguments verbatim to create_group for confirmation. This tool only reads Monday.

tools.name: create_group
tools.title: Create Monday.com group
tools.description: Use create_group_arguments from prepare_create_group verbatim to show the Create group confirmation. The card shows the board and lets the user edit the group name and position. For a spoken revision, use prepare_create_group with the current draft ID. Approval creates one empty group on the reviewed board. Only report success when the result confirms the group ID. Check Monday before retrying an unconfirmed creation.

children.label: Board and position

tools.name: prepare_archive_board
tools.title: Prepare Monday.com board archive
tools.description: Start every Monday board archive here, including a correction to the target while the Archive board confirmation is open or immediately after VoiceOS dismisses it for an edit. A short reply such as “I meant the testing one”, “the testing board instead”, or “testing” following that confirmation means archive testing. Keep the archive action from the latest confirmation. Call this tool with the corrected board_name and replaces_draft_id from that confirmation. If its draft ID is missing, use revises_board_name with the exact previous board name from this conversation. Use board_name or a verified board_id for the new target. If the result contains a question, ask it and use any matching_boards to clarify. Pass archive_board_arguments verbatim to archive_board to show a fresh confirmation. This tool only reads Monday.

tools.name: archive_board
tools.title: Archive Monday.com board
tools.description: Show the Archive board confirmation using archive_board_arguments from prepare_archive_board verbatim. The card lets the user change the board before approving. If the user says or types a different board, including “I meant the testing one”, keep the pending archive action. Call prepare_archive_board with the new board and the previous draft ID or exact previous board name, then show a fresh Archive board confirmation. Only approval archives the selected board. Check Monday.com before retrying an unconfirmed archive.

children.label: Board

tools.name: prepare_delete_board
tools.title: Prepare Monday.com board deletion
tools.description: Start here when the user asks to delete a Monday board or corrects the target of a pending Delete board confirmation. A short reply such as “I meant the testing one” after that card changes the board to testing and keeps the delete action. Pass the new board_name or verified board_id. For a correction, pass replaces_draft_id from the Delete board confirmation, or use revises_board_name with its exact previous board name if the ID is missing. If the result contains a question, ask it and use matching_boards to clarify. Pass delete_board_arguments verbatim to delete_board to show a fresh confirmation. This tool only reads Monday.

tools.name: delete_board
tools.title: Delete Monday.com board
tools.description: Show the Delete board confirmation using delete_board_arguments from prepare_delete_board verbatim. The user can change the board on the card. For a spoken or typed board correction, call prepare_delete_board and show a fresh Delete board confirmation. Approval moves the selected board to Monday.com Trash, where it can be recovered for 30 days. Report success only when Monday confirms deletion. Check Monday.com before retrying an unconfirmed deletion.

children.text: Monday.com moves the board to Trash, where it can be recovered for 30 days.

children.label: Board

tools.name: list_board_members
tools.title: List Monday.com board members
tools.description: Use for questions like “who is on the Marketing board?” Lists the named board’s owners and direct subscribers. If a question is returned, ask it. Pass board_id only to select a board the user confirmed from matching_boards. Use the full records for follow-ups, and summarize the names and roles aloud without reading IDs. If membership cannot be verified, report the error. Read only.

tools.name: prepare_manage_users
tools.title: Prepare Monday.com board membership change
tools.description: Start here for explicit requests to add existing Monday users to a board or remove direct subscribers from a board. Pass the board name and each person by name or email. Use role owner only for people the user explicitly asked to make board owners. Use me for a requested self-removal. If a question is returned, ask it, then retry with all clarified inputs. Pass board_id only to select a board the user confirmed from matching_boards. For a correction to a pending card, include replaces_draft_id and the complete corrected request. Pass manage_users_arguments verbatim to manage_users for confirmation. Read only.

tools.name: manage_users
tools.title: Manage Monday.com board members
tools.description: Show the confirmation card using manage_users_arguments from prepare_manage_users verbatim. Approval applies the displayed board membership changes. If the user corrects the board, people, or roles, prepare and show a new confirmation. Speak the result, including any provider errors or unconfirmed changes. Check Monday before retrying an uncertain change.

children.label: Board membership change
